decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan REV00EX01EX02EX03EX04EX05EX06PL01 REV00PL02PL03PL04PL05PL07Planning and Access Statement SuDs ProformaManagement and Parking PlanHighway Safety Impact Assessment   Flood Risk Assessment Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 6 people at any one time and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms, and the communal kitchen / dining room and living room shall be retained in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the amenity of neighbours and the residential character of the surrounding area.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved refuse storage details as set out in drawings PL01 Rev 00 and PL07 before the development is occupied. The refuse storage shall be retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure the provision of refuse storage in accordance with the London Borough of Enfield - Waste and Recycling Planning Storage Guidance 2024

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the cycle parking details as set out in drawings PL01 Rev 00 and PL06 before the development is occupied. The cycle parking shall be retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking in accordance with Policy T6.1 of the London Plan (2021), the Council's adopted standards and London Cycling Design Standards Chapter 8
